findings.label: Prerelease publishes to latest dist-tag
findings.detail: `npm publish` with no --tag tags 0.1.0-alpha as `latest`, so `npm install project-adx-0` would pull an alpha. Fine while it is the only version; add `--tag alpha` before a stable release coexists. Non-blocking.

findings.label: Symlink escape from served root
findings.detail: statSync follows symlinks and the serve containment check is purely lexical (no realpath), so a symlink inside the served root pointing outside would be served. Documented as a known assumption for a loopback preview over trusted compiler output; close with a realpath re-check if serve ever targets untrusted trees. Non-blocking.

findings.label: --host 0.0.0.0 is unauthenticated
findings.detail: Binding a non-loopback host serves build output to the LAN with no access control. Default localhost is safe and the exposure is documented in the serve help comment; appropriate while serve remains a local preview over trusted output. Non-blocking.

findings.label: No concurrency guard on publish workflow
findings.detail: Two near-simultaneous main pushes could run the publish job concurrently; the version guard still prevents a duplicate publish of the same version, but a `concurrency: publish` group would avoid the race entirely. Non-blocking.
